mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.2% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which may prompt the Fed to delay rate hikes and reduce real interest rate pressures, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE exceeds 4.2% (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, which triggers a market expectation of slower economic growth and potential Fed rate cuts, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05) or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 106.5 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which increases the likelihood of a Fed rate cut to stimulate the economy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO falls below 106.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to generate positive returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in housing starts above 1.4 million units in a single month signals strong consumer confidence and rising demand for durable goods, which supports corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST exceeds 1400.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal generates negative returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is above 2.5%, the market prices in a tightening cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS > 2.0 and CPIAUCSL > 2.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or the joint signal has Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment and decline in unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, which increases inflationary pressure and may lead the Fed to raise rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 100k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS rises >100k and UNRATE falls >0.2pp (t-test p > 0.05) or the joint signal fails to generate negative returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (proxied by RSAFS) combined with a flat or declining GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a weakening demand environment, which increases the probability of a Fed rate cut, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS declines and GDPC1 is flat or falling (t-test p > 0.05) or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
